title: Cap. III Sol. Rat. 4: pride; impossible in sin — efficacious grace only to predestined
pass_a_gloss: Further, it is not the best mode of electing, because it inflates a man with pride, while it assumes that each one by his own works has distinguished himself from the non-elect. Finally I add, it is so far from being the best that it is not even possible in this state of sin. For in a man corrupted by sin no merits efficacious to eternal life can be foreknown, unless God has freely given them. God gives such to no one except him to whom he decreed to give from eternity. To no one did he decree to give efficacious grace unto salvation except to those whom he predestined unto salvation. From first to last, therefore, the merits of such cannot be foreseen in those not yet elected to eternal life: They are not therefore elected to life from a preceding foresight of merits.
pass_b_english: Further, it is not the best mode of electing, because it puffs a person up with pride by assuming each has by his own works set himself apart from the non-elect. Finally: it is so far from best that it is not even possible in this state of sin. In a person corrupted by sin no merits efficacious for eternal life can be foreknown unless God has freely given them. God gives those only to whom he decreed from eternity to give. He decreed efficacious grace unto salvation only to those he predestined to salvation. From first to last, then, such merits cannot be foreseen in those not yet elected to eternal life — so they are not elected to life from a preceding foresight of merits.
source_text: Porro, non est optimus modus eligendi, quia hominem inflat superbia, dum supponit unumquemque suis operibus semet a non-electis discrevisse. Demum addo, tantum abest ut sit optimus, ut ne possibilis quidem sit in hoc statu peccati. In homine enim per peccatum corrupto nulla possunt praesciri merita ad vitam aeternam efficacia, nisi Deus gratuito illa dederit. Deus nulli dat talia, nisi cui decrevit dare ab aeterno. Nemini decrevit dare gratiam efficacem ad salutem, nisi illis quos praedestinavit ad salutem. A primo igitur ad ultimum, merita talium non possunt praevideri in nondum electis ad vitam aeternam: Non igitur ex praescientia meritorum praecedente ad vitam eliguntur.
